summary: The saved report describes eight simulated rock worlds, 16 cavity-present and 16 cavity-absent observations. Held-out calibrated interior score reports 100% sensitivity and 12.5% false positives in that smooth-geology set.
contrary: Five of eight strong solid-inclusion no-cavity controls triggered the calibrated interior score. The report explicitly warns that the current method cannot reliably exclude these impostors.
limit: The archive includes scripts, metrics and reports; Python 3.10+, NumPy, SciPy and Matplotlib are listed, but exact dependency versions and original execution environment are not established by this index. No new simulation or physical survey was performed for the Chronicle.
